meta.name: card-twitter
meta.description: 推特金句 / 数据卡, 适合配推文

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成推特风格的金句卡片和数据图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发推特需要配图来吸引眼球
copy.tagline_en: Generate tweet-style quote cards and data charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweet and need eye-catching images

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按模板生成 1600×900 的推特分享卡:中央放 2–3 行金句,下方署名与头像占位,左上角标签、右下角水印,并带网格/噪点纹理,可截图配推文。
howto.when: 当你说要“推特金句卡”“数据卡”或“配推文的分享图”等时,Claude 会套用此模板。

say.text: 把这句话做成推特金句卡:「少即是多」
say.note: 会生成 16:9 暗色金句卡,可截图发推。

say.text: 做一张 Data 类型的数据卡,深色背景
say.note: 左上角会出现 Data 标签,右下角加水印。

say.text: 给作者 @handle 的 quote 做张亮色分享卡
say.note: 会生成亮色卡片,含署名与头像占位。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will produce a 1600×900 Twitter share card from the template: a 2–3 line hero quote, author name/avatar placeholder, top-left type label, bottom-right brand watermark, and subtle grid/noise texture, ready to screenshot for a tweet.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a Twitter quote card, a data card, or a share image to accompany a tweet.

say_en.text: Turn this into a Twitter quote card: "Less is more."
say_en.note: Generates a 16:9 dark quote card ready to screenshot.

say_en.text: Make a Data-type card with a dark background.
say_en.note: Adds a Data label top-left and a watermark bottom-right.

say_en.text: Make a light share card for this quote by @handle.
say_en.note: Creates a light card with author name and avatar placeholder.
